label: a bare foot.
why: A bare foot with an electrode strap around the ankle, seen from above at an angle with the ankle at the top and the toes at the bottom right; the foot stays still while the camera tilts up the leg, so the foot slides down the frame. The clip has no hard cuts, but after about 2.0 s the foot leaves the frame and the shot moves on to the knee, a hand and a machine, so 0.0 to 2.0 is the only stretch where the whole foot is in view.
